title: Hebrews
author: The author is not named.
audience: Jewish Christians tempted to draw back under pressure.
historicalSetting: Hebrews exalts the superiority of Christ and calls believers to endure in faith.
keyVerse: Hebrews 12:2 — "Looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith."
christFocus: Hebrews is profoundly Christ-centered, presenting Jesus as the final revelation, perfect High Priest, once-for-all sacrifice, mediator, and object of enduring faith.
outline: Christ superior to angels and Moses — Hebrews 1-4
Christ the great High Priest — Hebrews 4-10
